nodes.label: Decision API Versioning and Idempotency Keys
API Versioning Header Strategy
nodes.rationale: X-API-Version header on /api/* responses (not URL prefix). OpenAPI version = package version. Additive-only within major. First breaking change ships as /api/v2 URLs; v1 gets 6-month sunset via Deprecation + Sunset headers. Chosen over URL-prefixing for single-tenant internal tool with one SPA consumer.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys Implementation
nodes.rationale: Idempotency-Key header on invoice create/generate-from-time/status change. Stored in Postgres idempotency_keys table (not Redis) to survive Redis flush. TTL 24h enforced lazily. Same key + same body = replayed response; same key + different body = 422 error.
